references.text: The Lord's promise to Abraham to give the land to his descendants - the same promise referred to in Deuteronomy 34:4
God repeats the promise to Abraham to give him and his descendants all the land he can see
The covenant with Abraham where God promises to give the land to his descendants
The promise repeated to Isaac to give the land to his descendants, as mentioned in Deuteronomy 34:4
The promise repeated to Jacob regarding the land that would be given to him and his descendants
Joseph reminds of God's oath to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob concerning the land
The Lord tells Moses that he will not enter the land, but the people will
The Lord informs Moses that he will not lead the people into the land because of his disobedience
Moses is told to view the land from the mountain, but that he must not enter it
Moses sees the land from Mount Pisgah but is not allowed to cross the Jordan
The Epistle to the Hebrews refers to the patriarchs who saw the promises from afar without receiving them, paralleling Moses who saw the land without entering
